SPIKE BELT

Switchback Ascent — overall concept and key-area urban design for the Centennial Jing-Zhang AI Innovation Belt. One axis, one branch, three switchbacks, two wings. The Ascent Axis is the 9.7 km Jing-Zhang Heritage Park spine; the Validation Axis branches south-east from the Beijing AI Origin Community.
⚠ This scheme uses a provisional rough boundary — not an official redline, not an approval basis, not a precise-area basis. Once official polygons are released every layer and metric must be recalculated. All spatial proposals are conceptual proposals for professional teams to develop, not statutory planning or a government determination.

Three-level scope

Coordinated research area
43.6 km²
Announced textual area. No official polygon, so it carries concept only and takes no part in spatial recomputation. It answers: how the AI ecosystem is organised and what the future urban form is.
Overall design area
11.41 km²
Recomputed from the provisional boundary. It answers how structure, land use, mobility, blue-green and character are drawn. Every layer on this page sits inside it.
Key detailed-design areas
368.4 ha
Announced textual area, three areas combined. Provisional rectangles whose edges must not be read as parcel or road redlines. They answer how the three areas reach detailed-design depth.

Key areas

North to south: Zhongzhiyuan (Ascent) → Beijing AI Origin Community (Switchback) → Dazhongsi (Delivery). Yellow dashes mark the provisional extent.

① Zhongzhiyuan AI Innovation Acceleration Area · ≈192.1 ha
ASCENT STATION — Full-stack indigenous AI + a global voice in AI governance. DECK ③ stitches east-west; an outdoor test ground, a buffer wedge and 6.0 ha of strategic reserve. Pending: 5th Ring noise buffering, plant ownership and structure, compute energy load and utility capacity.
② Beijing AI Origin Community · ≈104.3 ha
ORIGIN STATION — A world-class AI ecosystem + open-source origin and talent zone. The Spike Zero honour ring, a campus-adjacent innovation interface, the Tsinghuayuan Station cultural node. Pending: heritage extent and control zone, university land ownership, interchange towards Wudaokou.
③ Dazhongsi AI Industry Cluster · ≈72.0 ha
DELIVERY STATION — AI-native industries + content consumption and data-element conversion. DECK ① stitches four quadrants, the Compute Bell plaza, a 2.3 ha interchange site. Pending: heritage extent and control zone, junction traffic, underground feasibility.

Mobility

19 line features: 1 spine walkway, 1 validation axis, 3 DECK walkways, 3 transit links, 9 local-street loops, 2 cycle tracks.All alignments are schematic — not road redlines or engineering conclusions; interchange nodes are not actual stations.Pale blue discs are 800 m walking catchments, used only to check facilities and walking.

Blue-green & public space

All 58 green features derive from land-use classes 1401 / 1402, so the ratio can be checked two ways; 19 public-space features form the DECK + CHANNEL + K-MARK + station-square family. Red dots are the 4 AI pilgrimage landmarks (conceptual): Spike Zero, the Zhongzhiyuan DECK, the Compute Bell and the K0 origin K-MARK.

AI scenarios& PERSONAS

12 scenario cards, 4 of them industrial test scenarios. Every sensing scenario must be switchable off, explainable and human-overridable; none requires face recognition or identity profiling; a test scenario must not be described as approved operation before regulatory approval.

Six personas: university researcher / start-up technical founder / enterprise product manager / local elder / neighbourhood family / international visitor. Every card must answer three questions — which public-space feature it lands on, who operates it and when, and who switches it off when something goes wrong.

A century ago Zhan Tianyou traded length for height with a single reversal. From the first spike to this one, a century later the line still answers the same question — how to make an impossible height reachable.
